config.label: Funded Base-mainnet key that signs USDC micropayments
config.description: Funded Base-mainnet key that signs USDC micropayments. Either this or SOLANA_BUYER_SECRET enables paid tools; the free discovery tool needs neither.

config.label: x402 network: 'base' (mainnet, real USDC) or 'base-sepolia' (only against a testnet deployment)
config.description: x402 network: 'base' (mainnet, real USDC) or 'base-sepolia' (only against a testnet deployment).

config.label: Hard per-call price cap in USD
config.description: Hard per-call price cap in USD. Calls priced above it are refused before any payment. Default 0.05.

config.label: Override the API base URL
config.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the production deployment.

config.label: Funded Solana-mainnet key (64-number JSON array or base58) to also pay on Solana
config.description: Funded Solana-mainnet key (64-number JSON array or base58) to also pay on Solana. Optional — either this or BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY enables paid tools.

config.label: Solana network: 'solana' (mainnet) or 'solana-devnet'
config.description: Solana network: 'solana' (mainnet) or 'solana-devnet'. Defaults to match X402_NETWORK's testnet-ness.

config.label: Optional custom Solana RPC (the public mainnet-beta endpoint is rate-limited)
config.description: Optional custom Solana RPC (the public mainnet-beta endpoint is rate-limited).
